naicsTitle: Foundation, Structure, and Building Exterior Contractors
title: Top OSHA citations: foundation, structure and building exterior contractors (NAICS 2381)
seoTitle: Roofing safety and other NAICS 2381 trades: OSHA citations
description: OSHA standards cited most in foundation, structure and building exterior contractors (NAICS 2381), FY2022–FY2026: falls, ladders, training and PPE.
opening: In foundation, structure, and building exterior contractors (NAICS 2381), the OSHA standard cited most from FY2022–FY2026 was 1926.501, Duty to have fall protection, with 34,264 of 130,632 citations, followed by 1926.1053 on ladders.
patternsSummary: Falls and access lead the citations in NAICS 2381: 1926.501 (Duty to have fall protection) had 34,264 and 1926.1053 (Ladders) had 14,807, while 1926.502 (Fall protection systems criteria and practices) added 3,849 further down the list. Sections headed "Training requirements" recur, with 1926.503 at 13,866 citations, 1926.1060 at 1,796 and 1926.454 at 1,422. 1926.451, headed "General requirements" (11,283), ranks just ahead of the personal protective equipment standards 1926.102 on eye and face protection (10,390) and 1926.100 on head protection (5,049). Health hazards rank lower: 1910.1200 hazard communication had 4,677 citations and 1926.1153 respirable crystalline silica had 2,350.
penaltiesSummary: For FY2022–FY2026, the median penalty in this code was $3,457, and the middle range ran from $2,113 to $4,839. Of the citations, 75% were classed as serious, 10% as repeat, 1% as willful and 14% as other-than-serious.
